diagnostics.message: A boundary function (public, not nested) returns a raw dict. Prefer a @dataclass for internal boundaries, or a pydantic BaseModel where validation is needed (e.g. FastAPI endpoints). A lookup table (keys that are data) takes an alias whose name ends in `Table`; a private (`_name`) or nested function is not a boundary.
